0022600100.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (0-1, 8th in the West) visit the Utah Jazz (0-1, 12th in the West) in a matchup of two teams still looking for their first win of 2026-27. Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot strain) and Trey Alexander (out, knee bruise), and Tony Bradley is day-to-day with a quadriceps strain and is a game-time decision. The Pelicans won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 156-137 win in New Orleans on April 7, 2026, and the 2026-27 series has no games yet.
